parts.text: The first reference photo sets the sculpting style, clay finish, lighting and camera framing. The second reference photo is the character: keep the exact same face sculpt and head proportions. Change only what this description says: Photograph of a hand-sculpted stop-motion claymation figure, matte plasticine with fingerprints, tool marks and pressed texture, soft studio lighting, highly detailed, in exactly the style of the reference photos. A grotesque disfigured old man with an oversized bobble head, mottled skin with age spots, small sunken bloodshot eyes in swollen red-rimmed lids, a large ear with a fat hanging lobe, thick neck, hunched broad shoulders, head turned three-quarters toward the viewer's right. Head type: a SUBTLY cone-shaped skull, only slightly elongated, the crown rising gently to a soft rounded top, never a sharp point or a tall exaggerated cone, with faint ridged wrinkles running up the back, corpse-grey clay skin, completely bald, raised grey clay wrinkle ridges on the forehead. A frayed stitched burlap pig mask with floppy ears, a pink clay snout and a blocky burlap-toothed grin, a rusty leather strap with a buckle over the crown. Wearing a stained torn undershirt, a worn leather tool belt with rusty tools and pouches, he wields a heavy rusty chainsaw with a bloody chain in BOTH hands: right hand gripping the rear handle, left hand gripping the front wrap-around handle, the bar angled up and out across his body. A cream pressed-clay backdrop with blood-red dripping splatter. FACING: exactly like the first reference photo, his body is in three-quarter view and his head and face are turned about 45 degrees toward the RIGHT side of the image (the viewer's right), nose pointing right; never turned to the left side and never straight on. Three-quarter view from the hips up, whole head, mask and weapons inside the frame with a little space above the head, figure centred, square 1:1 composition. SCALE (the same for every figure in the series): the figure is the same size in the frame as in the first reference photo, the bobble head the same size relative to the body, and weapons true to scale with the hands, never oversized or tiny. Both hands hold the chainsaw firmly, one on the rear handle and one on the front handle; neither hand hangs empty. Avoid: text, logo, letters, watermark, brand marks, sports team logo, red chevrons or triangles on the mask, full-face goalie mask covering the forehead and eyes, white screaming ghost mask, black hooded robe, pins in a grid, extra fingers, deformed hands, cropped head, photo of a real person, cartoon outline, flat 2D, face turned to the left, mirrored pose, long finger blades, clawed glove with four long knives, red and green striped sweater, brown fedora
